Jesus went out of His way for one woman. 💧

Noon, at Jacob's well. A tired Jesus asks a Samaritan woman for a drink, offers her water that ends the thirst for good, tells her everything she ever did, and still stays. She leaves her waterpot and runs back to town: “Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did.”

Who needs to hear this today? Tag them 👇

5 seconds, no Googling. What are the twelve gates of the new Jerusalem made of? Comment ✅ or ❌ 👇
